name: QTREX Quantum Ltd.
summary: QTREX Quantum Ltd. is an Israel-based specialized medical device firm. Its core activities encompass the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of unique life support technologies aimed at treating acute respiratory failure. The company provides the INSPIRA ART100, a vital life support system designed for cardiopulmonary bypass procedures lasting up to six hours. Additionally, it offers the HYLA blood sensor, engineered to deliver real-time sampling and analysis of critical blood parameter measurements. Founded in 2018, the company previously operated as Inspira Technologies Oxy B.H.N. Ltd. before rebranding to QTREX Quantum Ltd. in May 2026. Its primary operations are headquartered in Ra'anana, Israel.
